title: docs: regenerate APIDOCS.md
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Auto-generated from OpenAPI spec changes after a successful production deploy.

gist.headline: The map caught up
gist.blurb: The API reference grew a fresh set of leaves after production shipped. Fewer mysteries, more endpoints with their little labels attached.
gist.summary: Regenerated APIDOCS.md from the production OpenAPI specification, bringing the public API reference in sync with deployed endpoints and schema changes.
gist.impact: Developers can use the updated APIDOCS.md as an accurate reference for the API currently running in production.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful garden librarian, pinning freshly printed API maps onto a cozy terminal bulletin board while code-plants grow from nearby pots. The visual metaphor is an updated map matching a living, deployed garden.
